reuse.why: Builds the rule into the existing shared getScheduledAmount, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, and routes the API, budget template, forecast, schedule actions, posting, preview and client views through it.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies in favour of the shared helper; the range and approximate cases are each written once.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, already used by server and client; the API field is computed in the API layer from that helper.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its callers, the API field and type, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: One helper owns the rule, but appending op after the boolean inverse forces 'false' at every call site, two extra helpers are exported without other users, and forecast-schedules takes the value from schedule._amount but the operator only from the conditions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every place that resolved a schedule amount now calls getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts gains an op parameter (the real variation) and an isapprox branch delegating to getApproximateWorstCaseAmount; no caller bypasses it.
